C0244.title: Review Study on Machine Learning for Email Spam Filtering
C0244.summary: Heliyon published this review paper in 2019. It surveys machine learning methods, feature extraction, classification evaluation, common datasets, and experimental metrics for email spam filtering, covering supervised learning, text classification, content analysis, and security detection. It also discusses dataset shift, adversarial changes, malicious links, deceptive content evolution, model generalization, and other open research problems in spam detection.
